text: Baga Beach in Goa: white sand, water sports, nightlife. Best time: Nov-Feb.
Lake Pichola in Udaipur: boat rides, palaces, romantic sunset views.
Amber Fort in Jaipur: hilltop fort, elephant rides, stunning architecture.
Kerala backwaters: houseboat cruises, palm-fringed canals, serene nature.
Pangong Lake in Ladakh: high-altitude lake, changing colors, breathtaking views.
